subject: Omar Top Deals portable pop-up merchandise business concept

facts: The working business name is Omar Top Deals.
Omar is a pop-up merchandise salesman with decades of sales and business experience.
Fritz described Omar as an old friend and mentor and supplied the photographs used in the concept.
No official domain, public email, social account, event schedule, product inventory, prices, payment account, or service area was confirmed for this build.

sources.design_use: Supports a future verified public business presence; not represented as configured in this prototype.
Supports future service-area treatment for a mobile pop-up merchant; no area is claimed today.
Supports a repeatable event and offer publishing workflow after account approval.
Supports the QR-at-the-table pattern; the prototype QR opens only the public showcase and does not collect payment.
Supports separately scoped inventory and selling-system options; no Square integration is represented as active.
Supports the owner-controlled payment-link principle; the prototype stores no payment link and processes no payment.
Supports keeping event/drop marketing consent optional and separate from a customer question or hold request.
Supports phone-friendly controls and forgiving tap targets.
Supports the visible motion control and reduced-motion fallback.

limitations: No external search result was treated as Omar's official business identity.
Provider pages describe possible capabilities, not a recommendation that Omar must buy or use those providers.
The business and operating facts require Omar's approval before a real launch.
